# CGI

> CGI is a global IT consulting and services company delivering application development, modernization, and enterprise solutions powered by AI, DevSecOps, and cloud technologies.

CGI provides comprehensive digital transformation services across multiple industries including banking, insurance, and financial services. The company specializes in application lifecycle management, AIOps, and industry-specific SaaS solutions designed to accelerate business innovation and operational efficiency.

## Key Topics

- Application Development
- Application Modernization
- DevSecOps
- AIOps
- AI Automation
- Cloud Migration
- Enterprise Solutions
- Digital Transformation
- Accel360
- AccelerateAI360
- AccuLender
- Financial Services
- Quality Assurance
- Digital Ecosystem
- SaaS

## Application Services

- [Application development and maintenance services](https://www.cgi.com/en/application-services): CGI's application development, maintenance and modernization services with DevSecOps and AIOps

## Enterprise Solutions

- [CGI Solutions](https://www.cgi.com/en/solution): CGI's enterprise solutions portfolio including Accel360, AccelerateAI360 and AccuLender
